title: The bluff worked: Rahane opens up on India's 2021 Australia series win
description:
Former India captain Ajinkya Rahane on Wednesday revealed he was "nervous" after taking over from regular skipper Virat Kohli post the team's 36 all-out debacle in Adelaide but his "bluff" against Australia and their media worked for him.
India were shot out for their lowest-ever Test total of 36 all-out for a horrendous start to the Australia tour in 2020-21 before a severely depleted team bounced back to win the series 2-1.
Rahane, who took over from Kohli as India's captain for the remainder of the series, is revered for rallying the troops in a spectacular manner on that famous tour Down Under.
"I remember one thought in my head, about when we lost the game in Adelaide, and then everyone started talking about that 'India will probably lose 4-0', and 'there's no chance for the Indian team..." Rahane said in a panel discussion for an event named "Beyond Boundaries".
The event was to mark the jersey unveiling of the Indian men's blind cricket team for the Asia Cup in November.
